title: Game Over
blurb: A descending minor-key game-over sting, straight from the golden age of arcades — synthesized fresh so it's original audio. It's the dignified way to announce failure: the run is dead, the attempt is over, insert coin to continue. Perfect for fail compilations, rage-quit moments, and the end of any plan that was doomed from the start. Free MP3 download.
origin: Original descending-arpeggio synthesis in the classic arcade game-over style.
